我的朋友大卫(My Friend David): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍妮娜的日常、喜好与月光小院。
Nina wears a T-shirt today. Nina and David are in the same class. The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. We played chess till midnight on Saturday.
After school, we play together. David likes bread too. We talk about history a lot. We eat rice almost every day.
Nina's favorite season is autumn. The spring market is big and clean. I like my life very much.
